Summary: Fix cpu-upgrade OOM on SfM jobs (root cause of 6a3fc7875f9c8079e0fb703c exit 137 OOMKilled). (1) ns-process-data now invoked with --num-downscales 0 instead of 3 — skips the 1x/2x/4x/8x image pyramid that splatfacto never reads. The parallel pool that built it peaked RAM above 32 GB on 500 frames at 1920x1080. (2) os.environ.setdefault(OMP_NUM_THREADS, 4) at top of main() so every COLMAP subprocess (feature_extractor, sequential_matcher, vocab_tree_matcher in standard + refine paths) inherits the cap. 8 vCPU * full SIFT parallelism was multiplying peak memory by 8x. Combined: keeps peak RSS under 32 GB for refine-scale joint sets too. Reviewed other 4 recent ERROR jobs and confirmed they were unrelated (CUDA driver on CPU node from pre-revert state, old worker image without --sfm-only, 20-frame test too few for mapper init). Pushed worker; Space RUNNING_BUILDING. Plan once built: queue cloudy refine against sunny base local-run-20260614-234541 via headless_remote_run.py --preset refine --refine-from local-run-20260614-234541 --video cloudy1 --video cloudy2 --yes.

ROOT CAUSE for the still-underlined links and invisible stars: Layout.astro's <style> block was scoped (Astro default cid-attribute scoping), so every site-wide rule I'd written only matched anchors carrying Layout's cid — i.e. zero descendants. Adding is:global made all the rules I'd shipped previously (no-underline + gold star + .st-studio-icon + pill exceptions) actually reach VideoCard / TaxonomyRail / SuggestionStrip / Header / Footer. Also dropped the decorative ::after-bar approach (too much false-positive coverage), switched star glyph from U+2B50 to U+2605 for reliable cross-font rendering, applied user's exact .st-studio-icon CSS (margin-right:5px, vertical-align:middle, margin-bottom:1px), added svg { overflow: visible !important } for the thumbs-down icon halo. New: default movie-clapper SVG fallback for favicon route (no more 204 gaps), drag-to-scroll on every horizontal chip strip ([data-chip-strip], .st-header__menu/nav, .st-suggestions__list, .st-footer__searches-grid) via global pointer event script with 6px movement threshold to swallow accidental clicks, removed footer max-width:78ch, Pagination windowSize 2→4 (now shows up to 9 inline numeric buttons) + new countVideos() client method + every category/actor/studio/search/videos-index page in all 4 apps fetches total in parallel and passes totalPages to <Pagination>. NEW SCHEMA: ALTER TABLE videos ADD COLUMN description TEXT applied directly to live OVH:5433/promking via psql (additive, no data loss). Drizzle schema + VideoDetail pydantic model + get_video SQL all updated. New VideoDescription.astro shared component: SSR-renders full text (SEO-friendly) but client-side clamps to 3 lines with Show more/less toggle that auto-hides when content already fits, wired into all 4 detail pages. fullvideos.ts now extracts description from .video_description / .description / .info_video

Summary: Fix /api/stream/[slug] returning 502 for what is really a 404. The handler now: (a) catches PromKingApiError(404) and surfaces it as 404 instead of generic 'API error' 502; (b) returns 404 (not 502) when source page fetch succeeds but contains zero <source> tags — this is the case the user hit (sexyprn cum-fantasy) and 502 was triggering NS_BINDING_ABORTED in the browser; (c) tries EVERY DB-stored quality URL in preference order on the fast path, not just the single picked one (one stale signed URL no longer kills the whole request); (d) tries every freshly extracted source URL on the slow path; (e) falls back to embedUrl when extraction yields zero sources; (f) widens the site query-param cast from 'fxv'|'pkt' to the full Site union so oneporn/sexyprn type cleanly. Replaced pickUrl() with orderCandidates() that returns ALL candidates sorted by preference. Edited apps/sexyprn/src/pages/api/stream/[slug].ts and synced to fxv/oneporn/pkt (the 4 files were byte-identical before and after). Type-check clean on all 4 apps. Tue, 24 Jun 2026.

Summary: tech-oracle: pipeline orchestrator + dedup with cross-vendor logic + Markdown publisher (Tue, 23 Jun 2026 03:00). theitguyde.com is set up pointing to greencloud. Hosting analysis: greencloud has 6.0GB available RAM, load avg 0.04, 24-day uptime - comfortably hosts the full RAG (~2GB peak when both BGE-small embedder + BGE-reranker-base loaded). Summary: tech-oracle: cross-encoder reranker added to RAG pipeline (Tue, 23 Jun 2026). User flagged we forgot reranking. Also raised Qwen3 question - clarified Gemini does NOT use Qwen3 (uses Google's own text-embedding-005), but Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B IS a strong open option (~+8-9 MTEB points over BGE-small). Recommended adding reranker BEFORE swapping embedder because the specific failure we saw (Chrome-Stable-Update scoring 0.65 against macOS-Photos query by 'update' keyword) is a textbook cross-encoder fix; Qwen3 swap is corpus-density-bound. Build: tech_oracle/rag/rerank.py wraps fastembed.rerank.cross_encoder.TextCrossEncoder (ONNX, no torch dep). Default BAAI/bge-reranker-base (~1GB, ~280M params). Outputs sigmoid-normalized 0-1 scores. retrieve_related_per_item now does two-stage flow by default: bi-encoder recall (pull top_k*5 at min_score 0.45) then cross-encoder precision (drop <0.4 rerank, return top_k). SearchHit.score gets replaced with the rerank score so downstream prompts see the more meaningful number. CLI rag search is rerank-on by default with --no-rerank escape; output table shows both rerank and bi-encoder scores. Live test on the actual 65-item corpus PROVED the value: 'my printer wont print after windows update' query - bi-encoder had near-flat 0.67-0.73 top-5, reranker found ONE clearly-best HP-driver-complaint item and promoted 0.674->0.821 while demoting all other printer chatter to <0.15. 'macos icloud photos stuck' query - bi-encoder returned 8 false-positives in 0.55-0.57 band (Chrome updates, unrelated printer items); reranker zeroed EVERY ONE to 0.000 (corpus genuinely has no macOS-Photos content; correct behavior). Distribution is decisively bimodal vs bi-encoder mushy 0.4-0.7: rerank says match=0.5+, plausible=0.1-0.5, no-match=<0.05. Cost: one-time 90s 1GB download; ~30-50ms per pair on CPU; ~5-7s extra per synthesis batch (well within budget). UTF-8 stdout fix applied to cli.py module

User asked for concrete numbers on bigger embedding models + live-vs-cron tradeoff, then to wire retrieval into synthesis. Benchmark inline (tests/benchmark_embed.py + resource_compat.py) compared BGE-small vs BGE-base on the same 65-item live corpus. Results: BGE-base is 2.8x slower per item (193.9 ms vs 69.5 ms), uses ~500MB more RSS (1567 vs 1068 MB), disk 1.75x (0.223 MB vs 0.127 MB at 65 items). Surprise: BGE-small actually scored HIGHER on direct-match queries (printer 0.731 vs 0.707, outlook 0.597 vs 0.541) - BGE-base's only clear win was better off-topic category discrimination (returned tech-news instead of printer noise on spacex query). Recommendation: stay on BGE-small until corpus reaches ~10k items. Live-vs-cron: both invisible on Clopeux at our load (sustained <0.1% CPU, ~120ms bursts per item). Cron simpler operationally; daemon offers freshness in minutes which we dont need. Summary: tech-oracle local RAG: lancedb + fastembed BGE-small (Mon, 22 Jun 2026 23:55 -> Tue, 23 Jun 2026). Picked the lightweight path the user worried about: ONNX-runtime BGE-small-en-v1.5 (no torch dep; ~150-300MB RAM, CPU-only) via fastembed, lancedb as embedded single-process vector store (no etcd/MinIO sidecars unlike Milvus). New deps: lancedb>=0.13, fastembed>=0.4 (brought onnxruntime, pyarrow, tokenizers - NO torch). New module tech_oracle/rag/{embed,store}.py: embed.py wraps fastembed.TextEmbedding with lazy lru_cache + normalize-to-unit + zero-vector for empty strings; store.py opens/creates a lancedb table 'items' with item_id+metadata+vec(384), search() returns SearchHit dataclasses with cosine similarity converted from L2 distance (vectors are unit-normalized so cosine = 1 - L2_sq/2). New SQLite migration: indexed_at column + items_indexed_idx. New store methods: recent_unindexed, mark_indexed, get_by_ids; stats() now reports unindexed count. New CLI: tech-oracle rag {index,search,stats}. UTF-8 stdout reconfigure at cli.py module top to fix UnicodeEncodeError from emoji in Reddit titles (Windows cp1252 codec breaks Rich tables on U+1F62B etc). Smoke test on the 65-item corpus: cold first-run 14.93s including 5-file ~6s model download; warm subsequent embedding ~120ms/item; lancedb disk 0.143 MB for 65 vectors (projected ~140MB at 100k); per-query warm latency ~200ms. Real semantic search proved working: 'my printer wont print after windows update' returned r/printers items with scores 0.731-0.712 (no literal word match - true semantic recall); 'outlook keeps crashing' returned 0.575 max (correctly low - we have ZERO outlook items in the index yet, signal scaling exactly as expected); 'spacex starship mars rocket' returned no hits above 0.5 (no false positives on unrelated queries). Resource verdict: invisible on a desktop being actively used - ComfyUI

Summary: tech-oracle two-stage synthesis split: 8B picks predictions, 70B rewrites fix hints (Mon, 22 Jun 2026 23:50). vault-raggae composition + cuVS Q&A first. Confirmed vault-raggae stack: Milvus standalone v2.4.13 (CPU image; not GPU), etcd, MinIO, bge-small-en-v1.5 int8 embedding (~2GB VRAM), mistral 7B 4bit local LLM (~5GB VRAM) + KV cache 8192 (kv_cache_fraction 0.4 of GPU pool, ~2-3GB). Dropping local LLM + KV cache frees ~7-8GB VRAM on Clopeux for ComfyUI / other workloads. cuVS already lives in Milvus via Knowhere -> RAFT -> cuVS; activate by switching to the milvusdb/milvus:v2.4.13-gpu image and using GPU_CAGRA / GPU_IVF_FLAT / GPU_IVF_PQ index types. Summary: Built Prom-King/tech-oracle (Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:00): a focused synthesis service for the tech-support prediction pipeline. Calls NVIDIA NIM Llama 3.3 70B Instruct (free build.nvidia.com endpoint via NGC_API_KEY/NVIDIA_API_KEY) to turn pre-ingested news/changelog items + deterministic Postgres breakage scores into ranked TechPrediction objects. Layout: uv-managed pyproject.toml (Python 3.11+), src/tech_oracle/{client,schemas,prompts,synthesize,cli,api}.py, tests/fixtures/sample_request.json (handcrafted realistic 2026-06 batch: KB5039340 Win11 24H2 wifi, Anthropic claude-2-5-sonnet deprecation, Copilot Pro price hike 2026-07-15, macOS 15.7 Keychain visibility change, Chrome 141 WebGPU/extensions breakage, NVIDIA 558.20 HDR/OBS bug + 6 breakage scores). Hard rules baked into the prompt: JSON-only output, every prediction must cite source_item_ids, must use provided scores as-given (no inventing stats), calibrated confidence (high needs >=2 corroborating items AND strong vendor breakage history), bias toward missing over inventing, kebab-case prediction_id slugs. Stack is dependency-light: httpx + pydantic + fastapi + typer + rich. Smoke test against real NIM 70B: 1m11s, 4975 tokens (3127 in / 1848 out), 6 predictions all schema-valid, all with citations and reasoning that references the supplied breakage scores. Calibration looked right: only the KB5039340 wifi item got HIGH/next_24h; the Anthropic deprecation 3 months out correctly got LOW/watch. Two fixes during testing: bumped default NIM timeout 120s->300s (env-overridable as NIM_TIMEOUT) because 70B with JSON mode + heavy prompt regularly takes >2min on free tier; relaxed PredictionResponse.usage from dict[str,int] to dict[str,Any] because NIM returns prompt_tokens_details=None. Service is library + CLI + FastAPI POST /predict, all hitting the same synthesize() function. Not deployed - lives locally under Prom-King/tech-oracle/ pending downstream pipeline pieces (Brave Search/RSS ingester, 8B enrichment worker, Postgres scoring DB, publishing CMS).

Summary: Revised the Real-Debrid torrent ranking algorithm in js/streaming.js. Fixes: (1) word-boundary regex so 'ts' no longer matches DTS audio, 'cam' no longer matches camera/campaign - previously most quality releases with DTS audio were penalized -10000 as Telesyncs. (2) Replaced N-concurrent checkRDCached Promise.all storm with a single batched checkRDCachedBatch() that uses RD's multi-hash instantAvailability endpoint (40 hashes per call, 250ms gap between chunks) - protects against rate-limiting. (3) Richer scoring: source tier (remux>bluray>web-dl>webrip>hdtv>dvdrip), codec bonus (AV1/HEVC>AVC), HDR/DV tier (DV>HDR10+>HDR), Atmos/TrueHD/DTS-HD bonus, log-curve seeder health with dead-torrent penalty, size sanity (rejects fake 4K under 6GB and oversized over 80GB remuxes per quality tier), encoder reputation (YIFY penalty, FraMeSToR/QxR/etc bonus). (4) Quality scoring now rewards exact match of the user's preferred quality ceiling more strongly (+100 vs scaled tq*15).

Summary: Multi-video refine. --video is now action=append so the launcher accepts N clips; first is the manifest primary, rest go into manifest.metadata.extra_videos. _run_frame_extraction loops over extra_videos AFTER the primary: each extra is ffprobed for duration, extracted at compute_extraction_fps into its own TemporaryDirectory, blur-pruned to FRAME_KEEP_TARGET (so a long clip cannot monopolise the budget), then moved into frames/ with an extra<N>_ prefix. Per-video pruning is the point: with combined-set pruning a 348s cloudy + 130s sunny would land 73% cloudy. Base-job merge still runs last with a base_ prefix. Net: sunny (base) ~280 + cloudy1 ~280 + cloudy2 ~280 = ~840 frames into one COLMAP run.

Summary: Two viewport tweaks. (1) Lowered OrbitControls.rotateSpeed from 0.5 to 0.25 — left-drag orbit was too hot, especially after the free-look path was tuned slower. (2) Moved the contextmenu suppression from rendererCanvas to document. The native right-click menu fires on right-mouse-UP, and during free-look the cursor often drifts off the canvas before release, so the previous canvas-scoped listener missed the event and the menu opened on whatever element was under the pointer at release.

Removed FPS pointer-lock code (mode rename fpsMode->lookMode, fpsYaw/Pitch->lookYaw/Pitch, FPS_TARGET_DISTANCE->LOOK_TARGET_DISTANCE) and the both-buttons trigger (right alone is now the canonical binding; both-buttons no longer special-cased).

Summary: Added free-look pivot mode to viewer.js. Holding BOTH mouse buttons simultaneously snapshots camera.quaternion as fpsBaseQuat, disables OrbitControls, and rotates the camera in place via the same scalar yaw/pitch math FPS mode uses — but WITHOUT engaging pointer lock, so the cursor stays visible for precise framing. Releasing either button restores OrbitControls. Free-look takes priority when both go down during pointer-lock FPS: exitPointerLock is called before flipping the freeLook flag so the pointerlockchange handler does not re-enable OrbitControls between modes. Window blur clears both button state and freeLook to avoid stuck-in-free-look after alt-tab. Status line at scene-load now advertises the binding.

Summary: Per-job sticky Flip Up + game-style FPS pitch fix. (a) Viewer now persists the Flip Up state to <job>/usd/viewer_state.json via a new ViewportBridge.viewerFlipChanged(bool) slot. JS flipCameraUp toggles isFlipped and notifies Python; Python loads the JSON on reload_scene and appends flip=1 to the viewer URL when set; JS auto-calls flipCameraUp({silent: true}) at load. Fixes gravity_align PCA-skewness occasionally guessing up-down backward on backyard scenes without making the user click Flip Up every reload. (b) Rewrote FPS pointer-lock math: previous axis-angle premultiply with reject-on-overshoot was rejecting EVERY pitch delta when the camera started polar (single-axis movement symptom the user reported). New approach snapshots camera.quaternion at FPS entry as fpsBaseQuat, accumulates scalar fpsYaw + fpsPitch, builds orientation as qPitch * qYaw * fpsBaseQuat each frame. Pitch trivially clamped to +/-88.8deg; base preserves any Flip Up roll so mouselook stays correct after righting. Also noted user workflow: P key in the viewer toggles dot visualization to surface sparse regions for next capture session (saved to memory).

Summary: FPS-mode follow-ups. (a) Replaced Euler YXZ yaw/pitch tracking with axis-angle quaternion premultiply against camera.quaternion. Reason: setFromEuler discarded any roll introduced by Flip Up, so after the user righted the scene their mouselook felt inverted; premultiply preserves it. Yaw axis is the (mutable) worldUp shared with flipCameraUp, so Flip Up now also flips A/D and E/Q via the cross-product / scaled-worldUp paths. Pitch clamp via |forward.dot(worldUp)| < cos(~1deg) instead of explicit Euler clamp. (b) Cached SceneBounds in ViewportTab keyed on (preview_ply path, mtime). bounds_from_preview_ply was reading 200K points and running np.percentile on every Apply+Preview Pattern click — measured hundreds of ms felt by user as ~1.5s mode-switch pause. _get_bounds_cached returns the cached instance; set_job invalidates.

Summary: Added FPS pointer-lock camera mode to viewer.js. Right-click+hold locks the cursor and enters game-style mouselook (yaw around world +Y, pitch around camera-right, roll forced to 0 via Euler YXZ, pitch clamped to +/-89deg). WASD walks along camera horizontal-forward (pitch does not slow walking); QE raises/lowers along world up. On lock, OrbitControls is disabled; on release, target snaps to camera_pos + forward*3 so capture poses and post-FPS orbit pivot stay coherent. Also enforced camera.up=(0,1,0) at scene load so gravity-aligned splats no longer start upside down (removes need to hit Flip Up on every load). Status line updated to advertise the new control. captureCamera() unchanged — still derives lookAt from controls.target, which the FPS handler keeps on the camera ray.

Summary: FXV + PKT tube site overhaul. FXV: dropped iframe-only providers (freesexvideos, spankbang); rewired provider profiles for owned-player only (mp4/HLS); added eporner as new direct-stream source with detail-page extraction (fxv_extract_eporner_source); added fxv_actor + fxv_studio taxonomies; per-source actor/studio extraction; hardened per-source fetchers to skip candidates without extractable direct mp4/m3u8/webm URLs (topvid now requires HLS manifest extraction inline); fxv_resolve_runtime_embed falls back to 'unsupported' instead of 'iframe'; updated source catalog + domain map + admin allowlist hints. PKT: added pkt_actor + pkt_studio taxonomies; tightened per-source XPath (xvideos requires video_<digits> + non-channel anchor, xhamster requires /videos/ link, spankbang requires /<key>/video/); added URL_REJECT_PATTERNS (channels/playlists/profiles/series) and CONTENT_REJECT_PATTERNS ('Trust and Safety', 'podcast', 'episode', etc.) to fix prior PH-podcast contamination; redtube API handler now extracts actors from stars/models/pornstars + applies same content filters; added handle_wipe_and_backfill admin handler (requires typed WIPE confirmation) that deletes every pkt_video post, clears seen+cursors+poisoned keywords, then runs bulk fetch across xvideos+xhamster+spankbang+redtube targeting ~50 pages each. Shared: rewrote pkt-player.bundle.js to support hls.js via jsdelivr CDN for non-Safari browsers, added 'unsupported' player mode with source-page link CTA, removed automatic iframe fallback on HLS failures; mirrored JS+CSS to both plugins. Templates: reduced FXV archive inline ad (12->24), removed FXV in-player overlay ad, reduced PKT archive inline ad (3->15), removed PKT below-embed ad slot, added actor+studio chip rows to single-video templates. CSS: added .pkt-player-modal__unsupported + credit chip styles; harmonized PKT brand-icon fallback paths and play-icon fallback SVG (removed lone emoji). All modified PHP lints clean.

Summary: Round 3 feedback fixes — eight items. (1) CRITICAL bug fix: prompts/textareas were uneditable because FlowCanvas initialized rfNodes from storeNodes once and never re-synced. Added a useEffect in FlowCanvas that propagates store data changes (params, label) to rfNodes while leaving position/measured state untouched (preserves the visibility:hidden fix from earlier sessions). Identity-checks on params and label avoid spurious re-renders. (2) Toast system: new src/ui/components/Toast.tsx with module-level event hub (pushToast/dismissToast from anywhere) and ToastHost mounted at App root; renders top-right stack with auto-dismiss (6s default, 4s for success); three tones (error/success/info) with matching tokens. App.tsx now pushes 'success' on clean run, 'error' on per-node or top-level failure + auto-opens the inspector. (3) Execution errors moved to TOP of NodeParamPanel — banner with the failure detail + a Reset button; the old bottom error block was removed. Per-node text/json outputs still render below (image results render inline ON the comfyui_workflow node). (4) Removed the auto-created Display node from loadFromComfyWorkflow; the master flow is now just the single comfyui_workflow node, with results rendering inline (gallery + thumbnails). Eliminates the disconnected 'Result' node that felt orphaned. (5) Inline image result on ComfyUIWorkflowNode: when the workflow succeeds and the result has imageUrl/imageUrls, the gallery renders inside the node card itself; click any thumb opens full-size in a new tab. (6) New InlineSeedInput in canvas/nodes/inline.tsx — number input with a dice button (Lucide Dice5) that fills a 31-bit random int. ComfyUIWorkflowNode routes any input key named 'seed' through this control. (7) Size presets dropdown — when a workflow exposes both 'width' and 'height' in input_paths, a single 'size' InlineSelect drives both (512², 768², 1024², portrait/landscape variants, Custom reveals manual w/h number inputs). Exported SIZE_PRESETS array from inline.tsx. (8) NodeId pill — small mono badge at the bottom of every node card showing 'node#<short-id>'; tooltip on hover reveals the full id. shortenNodeId helper formats numeric/short/UUID ids consistently. (9) Persisted last-used inputs: ComfyUIWorkflowNode reads localStorage['vw:lastInputs:<workflow_id>'] on mount if all inputs are empty, prefills non-image fields (upload tokens excluded — they expire); debounced 400ms save on every input change. Each user gets their own browser-local memory of last prompt/seed/size per workflow. Deployed dist (assets/index-BxACQy3N.js).

Summary: Identified and fixed the real cause of the startup crash. After scanning a directory, the frontend called schedule-idle-previews with all items. For large folders or cloud directories (like iCloud Photos with 2,100+ items), this ran over 6,000 synchronous I/O operations (fs.existsSync) in a single loop on the main process thread, blocking the Electron main thread and triggering a native access violation crash/watchdog lock. Optimized the handler in previews.js to skip automatic background previews for cloud-backed directories (iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox, etc.) and limited active batch size to 80 items in other folders. Rebuilt installer successfully.

Summary: Landed A2: full real-time progress + cancel for comfyui_workflow nodes. Backend (vaultwares-pipelines): added websockets dependency (16.0) to .venv + requirements.txt. _execute_comfyui_graph now takes optional progress_cb + cancel_event args. Spawns _comfyui_ws_listener as an asyncio.Task that subscribes to ws://127.0.0.1:8188/ws?clientId=<id>, filters events by prompt_id, calls progress_cb with executing/progress/executed/execution_error/execution_success/execution_cached events. If cancel_event is set during execution, POSTs to ComfyUI's /interrupt and raises RuntimeError('canceled'). _execute_workflow_run plumbs both through. Job worker creates: (a) a progress_cb closure that maintains a progress_state dict and writes it to job.progress with throttling (~5 Hz), (b) a watch_cancel asyncio.Task that polls the job record once per second and sets cancel_event when status==canceled. JobSummary/JobDetail gained a progress field. New GET /jobs/recent endpoint (registered before /jobs/{job_id} to avoid the same path-conflict the validation endpoint hit) returns the caller's most recently-updated job, filterable by kind and CSV status; admins see all jobs, non-admins only their own (matched via requested_by.username or special 'vault-flows' tag). Frontend (vault-flows): listed JobSummary + JobProgress types in client.ts; getRecentJob(opts) handles the 'null' body case; cancelJob(id) calls POST /jobs/{id}/cancel. New ExecutionProgressOverlay.tsx renders a fixed bottom-right card while executionStatus==='running' — polls /jobs/recent at 1 Hz, shows a pulsing accent dot, progress bar (when total>0), current message, node + step counter, elapsed time, and a Cancel button that calls cancelJob. App.tsx mounts the overlay. Verified end-to-end: started a 30-step run, observed live step progress (poll showed step 4/12, then step 2/30 etc, with current node id 3), POST /jobs/{id}/cancel mid-execution → worker tripped /interrupt → /flows/run returned with error='ComfyUI workflow was canceled', final job status=canceled. Deployed dist (assets/index-DCi4ZtfE.js) atomically.

DisplayNode in vault-flows now renders a 2-column 80px grid when imageUrls.length > 1 (clickable thumbnails open full size in new tab, +N indicator for more than 6 images), single-image view unchanged. End-to-end verified: validation endpoint returns 14 workflows with correct verdict tally (3 pass / 3 broken_wiring / 4 blocked_subgraph / 3 blocked_unknown_pack / 1 blocked_missing_model); z-image-turbo run returns kind=image with imageUrls.count=1. Summary: Fixed 'logged in but getting 401' UX by persisting the JWT in sessionStorage instead of in-memory-only, and bumped pipelines JWT_TTL_SECONDS from 900 (15 min) to 3600 (1 hour). Frontend (src/api/client.ts): setToken/getToken now read/write sessionStorage key 'vw_jwt' with try/catch fallback to in-memory. Added clearToken() for use on stale-token detection. In-memory mirror kept for fetch-path perf. getMe() return type corrected from {id,username,role} to MeResponse{username,is_admin} matching pipelines schema. App.tsx: useEffect on mount that, if getToken() is set, calls getMe() and either rehydrates currentUser (success) or calls clearToken()+nulls user (401). This makes page refresh in the same tab keep the user logged in, while tab close still clears the token. Pipelines (.env): JWT_TTL_SECONDS=3600 — verified via login -> JWT payload exp-iat=3600s. NSSM service restarted. Built + deployed dist (assets/index-GzA-V8ki.js) atomically to greencloud-vps; live on flows.vaultwares.ca + noddit.org. Tradeoff acknowledged: sessionStorage tokens are XSS-readable but vault-flows has no untrusted user content injection points; httpOnly cookie auth was considered but requires a bigger pipelines refactor and isn't needed yet.

Agent: AI Agent (role: main) Model: unknown Thinking: unknown Mode: unknown Permissions: unknown (network: unknown) CWD: C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Github Repos\vault-flows  Branch: main Tools used (this reply): none MCP servers accessed (this reply): none Time: 2026-05-24 09:48 (TZ: Eastern Standard Time)

Summary: Three workflow-toolchain improvements addressing 'workflow runs in ComfyUI but fails validation' false positives. (1) Converter (convert_proven_workflows.py): skips nodes with mode==2 (muted) and mode==4 (bypassed); for bypassed nodes, rewires consumer links from bypassed_node.output[N] to whatever feeds bypassed_node.input[N], following chains of bypasses. This is exactly what ComfyUI's editor's 'Bypass' mode does at runtime. Eliminates dangling links + 'missing model' false positives where the referenced model was in a bypassed node. (2) Fixer (fix_workflows.py): smarter _core_key() that strips quant markers (FP16/FP8/Q2_K/etc), distillation markers (DMD/DMD2/distilled), AIO/base tags, and minor-version suffixes (V1.0/V1.1/v1-1) — so different-quant or patch-version files of the same base model are treated as drop-in substitutes. Closest_match() now uses the core-key tier as high-confidence matching (returns first match, prefers top-level files over nested copies). Also added Pass 3: normalize_load_image_widgets() replaces baked-in LoadImage filenames with a placeholder ('000.jpeg' from D:\\comfyui\\resources\\comfyui\\inputs) so ComfyUI's validator passes; the worker overrides at runtime. (3) Diagnostic (dump_workflows_diagnostic.py): validate_locally() now exempts LoadImage's image input from validation for any node referenced by step.image_inputs[] — runtime-overridden inputs are never structurally broken from the worker's POV. Re-seeded: 13/13 workflows now match the fixed JSONs (muted nodes dropped, bypasses rewired). New verdict tally: PASS=3 (biglove-photo, ipadapter-faceswap, z-image-turbo-text2img), BLOCKED_SUBGRAPH=4 (custom-realistic, flux-conditioner-sampler-upscaler, qwen-image-text2img, gonzalomo-dmd-v30), BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_PACK=3 (copilot/flux2-klein-faceswap/wan22 — AI-invented), BROKEN_WIRING=2 (basic-lora-text2img orphan upscale chain, qwen-edit-multi-angle unwired CLIP), BLOCKED_MISSING_MODEL=1 (openpose-i2i), VALIDATION_OTHER=1 (qwen-image-edit-4step references muted ReferenceLatent). All remaining issues are real workflow content problems requiring editor surgery.
